item.title: India's April-August fiscal deficit at 42% of 2026/27 target
item.description: India's fiscal deficit in the months of April to August stood at 7.1 trillion rupees ($74.09 billion), or 41.9% of the target for the financial year ending March, government data showed on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's fiscal deficit (INFISC=ECI) in the months of April to August stood at 7.1 trillion rupees ($74.09 billion), or 41.9% of the target for the financial year ending March, government data showed on Wednesday. The deficit in the same period last year stood at 6 trillion rupees. Here are more details India has set its fiscal deficit target for the financial year ending 2027 at 4.3% of GDP, or 16.96 trillion rupees. Net tax receipts for April to August stood at 8.4 trillion rupees, compared with 8.1 trillion rupees a year ago. Non-tax revenue was at 4.5 trillion rupees, compared with 4.4 trillion rupees a year ago. Total government expenditure was at 20.8 trillion rupees, compared with 18.8 trillion rupees a year earlier. Capital expenditure, or spending on building physical infrastructure, stood at 5.1 trillion rupees against 4.3 trillion rupees a year ago. ($1 = 95.8300 Indian rupees)

item.title: TSX futures edge higher ahead of US inflation data
item.description: Futures tracking Canada's main stock index edged higher on Wednesday as investors awaited key US inflation data that could offer fresh clues on the Federal Reserve's policy outlook.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Futures tracking Canada's main stock index edged higher on Wednesday as investors awaited key US inflation data that could offer fresh clues on the Federal Reserve's policy outlook. December futures on the S&P/TSX index were up 0.1% at 06:33 a.m. ET (1033 GMT). The US GDP and Personal Consumption Expenditures inflation reports due later in the day were expected to be the main market catalysts, with a stronger-than-expected inflation reading likely to extend the recent rise in global bond yields Brent crude was on track for a monthly gain of about 14%, its biggest since July, as investors grappled with persistent supply disruptions in the Middle East. Gold prices also firmed, though the metal remained on course for a monthly loss as expectations of higher interest rates weighed on sentiment Trade tensions between the US and Canada came into the spotlight after [USN:L6N45L136 TEXT:"Washington's ban"] on many Canadian alcoholic beverages, motorcycles and dairy products took effect on Tuesday Canada's benchmark S&P/TSX composite index (.GSPTSE) was set to snap a five-month winning streak following a turbulent September marked by rising global bond yields, a Fed rate hike and escalating Canada-US trade tensions Still, the index was on track to post a ninth straight quarterly gain, its longest such streak on record. Prime Minister [USN:T5N43901J TEXT:"Mark Carney"] said Canada will hold Cleveland-Cliffs (CLF.N) accountable for its commitments after the steelmaker announced plans to idle production at an Ontario facility, putting hundreds of jobs at risk FOR CANADIAN MARKETS NEWS, CLICK ON CODES: TSX market report Canadian dollar and bonds report CA/ Reuters global stocks poll for Canada Canadian markets directory

item.title: 英中銀、金融リスク顕在化を警告 イラン紛争とＡＩ債務増で
item.description: ［ロンドン ３０日 ロイター］ - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は３０日、イラン紛争の再激化や人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の債...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英中銀、金融リスク顕在化を警告　イラン紛争とＡＩ債務増で 19:52 配信

ロンドンのイングランド銀行本部、9月16日撮影 REUTERS/Corey Rudy

［ロンドン　３０日　ロイター］ - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は３０日、イラン紛争の再激化や人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の債券発行増加を挙げ、金融システム内で相互につながる脆弱性が顕在化するリスクが高まっていると警告した。

英中銀の金融安定政策委員会（ＦＰＣ）は、原油・天然ガス価格の上昇を受け、債券利回りが２００８年以来の水準に上昇したと指摘した。

金融システムと株式市場はこれまでのところ強靭（きょうじん）性を示しているものの、急激な調整の危険性がくすぶっていると警告。金融リスクに応じて水準を調整する「カウンターシクリカル資本バッファー」を２％に据え置いた。

ＦＰＣは四半期会合の議事要旨で、「金融システムの相互に関連する脆弱性が顕在化する可能性は高まっている」と指摘。「具体的には、紛争の再激化とそれに伴う原油、天然ガス、石油製品の価格上昇が、負の供給ショックを一段と長引かせている」とした。

＜ベイリー総裁、ＡＩリスクに懸念＞

ＦＰＣの議長を務めるベイリー英中銀総裁は、ＦＰＣ議事要旨と同時に公表したＡＩリスクに関する寄稿で、最先端ＡＩのリスクへの懸念を詳述し、規制強化の前に「導入の前後に実施する厳格なモデル検証」が必要だと指摘した。

「いずれ、より正式な規制の枠組みが整備される可能性は十分にある。しかし、規制策定から始めるのは適切ではない。まず理解と検証を進め、確実に介入できるポイントを定める必要がある」と記した。

ＦＰＣは、ＡＩ関連の債券発行の「急増」により、資本市場がＡＩの動向に左右される度合いも高まったと指摘した。モルガン・スタンレーが９月上旬に示した推計によると、世界のＡＩ関連債券発行額は約４５００億ドルと、２０２５年の２倍に達した。

ＡＩ関連株と半導体株は７月に急落したものの、市場機能は秩序を保った。ただ、バリュエーションが依然として高い中、より大きなショックが発生すれば、一段と急激な価格調整につながりかねないと英中銀は警告した。

ＡＩシステムが安全措置を回避する可能性を巡り、一連の事案が政策当局者の懸念を強めている。７月にはオープンＡＩのＡＩエージェントが管理された試験環境を抜け出し、ＡＩ企業ハギング・フェイスに不正侵入した。

英中銀は「こうした動きにより、ＡＩの進歩がサイバーリスクや業務運営上のリスクを高める可能性があるとの委員会の評価が一段と裏付けられた」とした。

＜銀行レバレッジ規制と英国債レポ市場改革＞

英中銀は、銀行のレバレッジ規制と英国債レポ市場のルールの変更について、２７年初めにより詳細な案を示すと表明した。英国債レポ市場では、トレーダーが金利変動による利益を狙うほか、投資家が保有債券を利用して一時的に現金を調達している。

ＦＰＣは７月、銀行に総資産に対して一定比率以上の自己資本を保有するよう求めるレバレッジ比率規制について、その影響を緩和する方針を示した。

変更案に関する市中協議は２７年初めに開始する。英中銀は、これにより「英国債レポ市場の強靭性を高める措置の策定と実施を引き続き進める重要性が増す」とした。

ブリーデン副総裁は７月、英国債レポ市場の規制について「何もしないという選択肢はない」と述べた。金融危機時に同市場が原因で債券取引が滞るリスクが残っているためだ。

英中銀のデータによると、英国債レポ市場の純借入額は計約２０００億ポンド（２７００億ドル）。英中銀は、ヘッジファンドのレバレッジがここ数カ月、高水準ながら安定して推移したと説明した。

英中銀は、２０年のコロナ禍と、２２年にトラス首相（当時）の大型減税策が招いた市場混乱（トラスショック）で市場介入を余儀なくされた経緯を踏まえ、２５年に規制強化の初期案を示した。

ただ、金融業界はこれらの案に反発している。ブリーデン氏は、中央清算の利用拡大など一部の改革には「数カ月ではなく、数年かかる可能性が高い」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ 最終更新: 9/30(水) 19:52 ロイター

item.title: Las fuerzas de EEUU salen de Irak y envalentonan a los grupos aliados de Irán y a Estado Islámico
item.description: Las fuerzas estadounidenses pusieron fin el miércoles a su misión en Irak tras más de dos décadas de guerra en el país, lo que suscitó temores a un vacío de seguridad que envalentone a las milicias chiitas respaldadas por Irán y permita a Estado Islámico reagruparse.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Rasheed, Muayad Hameed
item.content:encoded: Las fuerzas estadounidenses pusieron fin el miércoles a su misión en Irak tras más de dos décadas de guerra en el país, lo que suscitó temores a un vacío de seguridad que envalentone a las milicias chiitas respaldadas por Irán y permita a Estado Islámico reagruparse. La retirada de los últimos militares, principalmente de una base aérea en Erbil, en la región semiautónoma kurda, fue celebrada como una victoria por Teherán y sus aliados, aunque muchos iraquíes temían que sus propias fuerzas de seguridad no estuvieran preparadas. La retirada se acordó en 2024 durante la presidencia de Joe Biden y fue ejecutada por el Gobierno de Donald Trump, pese a que libra una guerra contra la vecina Irán. Se produce 23 años después de que las fuerzas lideradas por Estados Unidos derrocaran a Sadam Huseín, lo que desencadenó años de agitación y caos. Las tropas estadounidenses se retiraron inicialmente a finales de 2011, pero regresaron menos de tres años después, cuando los combatientes de Estado Islámico se apoderaron de un tercio de Irak. Más de 4.500 militares estadounidenses murieron en la mayor guerra librada por Estados Unidos en este siglo, aproximadamente el doble que en la guerra paralela de Afganistán. El proyecto Iraq Body Count afirma que murieron más de 200.000 civiles iraquíes. El Pentágono dijo que Estados Unidos y sus socios de la coalición dieron por concluida formalmente la operación "Resolución Inherente" y que seguirá proporcionando capacitación específica y apoyo de inteligencia a sus socios iraquíes. Se espera que los iraquíes encabecen los esfuerzos para garantizar la seguridad del país, aliado tanto de Washington como de Teherán, y mantener a raya a los remanentes de Estado Islámico. "El fin de la misión de la coalición internacional no significa el fin de nuestra lucha contra el terrorismo, sino la transición de Irak a una fase en la que asume plena responsabilidad por su seguridad y estabilidad", dijo el primer ministro iraquí, Alí Faleh al-Zaidi, en un comunicado. Teherán ha afianzado de forma constante su influencia en Irak a través de grupos aliados desde la caída de Sadam. Aunque la salida de las fuerzas estadounidenses goza de amplio respaldo entre los iraquíes, algunos temen que las fuerzas de seguridad entrenadas y financiadas por Estados Unidos aún no puedan proteger el país. "La lección de las últimas dos décadas es que los vacíos de seguridad pueden ser extremadamente peligrosos", dijo Yasim al-Bahadli, un analista iraquí que asesora a las fuerzas de seguridad. Adil Salman, de 45 años, profesor de inglés de secundaria, dijo que los iraquíes "no deberían apresurarse a celebrar" la retirada. "Las milicias siguen operando fuera del control del Estado y (Estado Islámico) aún no ha desaparecido", dijo. "Me preocupa que la salida de Estados Unidos pueda dar paso a un nuevo período de inestabilidad. Al final, la gente juzgará esta decisión por una sola cosa: si la situación de seguridad se mantiene estable en los próximos años". Con la presencia de fuerzas estadounidenses junto a grupos armados aliados de Irán, Irak se ha visto involucrado en la guerra de este año. De los 18 militares estadounidenses registrados como muertos desde que Trump lanzó la operación "Furia Épica" junto con Israel en febrero, siete murieron en Irak. El último fue un sargento del Ejército que murió durante la detonación controlada de un dron en una base cercana a Erbil en julio. Irán, que afirma que su objetivo último es obligar a las fuerzas estadounidenses a abandonar todo Oriente Medio, presenta la retirada de Estados Unidos de Irak como un triunfo de su "eje de la resistencia", integrado por grupos armados aliados en toda la región.

item.title: Fincantieri shipyard accident kills worker, critically injures another
item.description: A man died and another was seriously injured after an accident at a shipyard operated by Italy's Fincantieri in the port city of Ancona, the shipbuilder and police said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A man died and another was seriously injured after an accident at a shipyard operated by Italy's Fincantieri (FCT.MI) in the port city of Ancona, the shipbuilder and police said on Wednesday. The accident occurred late on Tuesday when a fire broke out as the two workers were carrying out welding work on a vessel. Police are investigating the cause of the blaze, which local unions said may have been due to a fault involving a welding machine. Both men were employed by a subcontractor, Fincantieri said. The victim was a 54-year-old Tunisian who died from severe burns, a local union official said, while the critically injured worker is a 29-year-old Bangladeshi. Local media reported that he is due to be transferred from Ancona's regional hospital to a specialist burns unit in the Tuscan city of Pisa. Italy's main metalworkers' unions - Fiom, Fim and Uilm - staged a protest at the shipyard and began immediate eight-hour strikes covering the day's shifts. National unions called for a two-hour strike across all Fincantieri's shipyards from Wednesday. "Safety culture needs to change, it is too often viewed solely as a business cost," a local union statement said, calling fro greater investments in training and protective equipment. The unions also called for a review of Italy's contracting and subcontracting practices, saying workplace accidents were more common in places where subcontractors worked.

item.title: Sterling at strongest in over a month versus euro after GDP revision reinforces BoE hike bets
item.description: Sterling hit a 6-week high versus the euro on Wednesday after data showed the UK economy grew faster than previously expected in the second quarter, cementing expectations for an interest rate hike by the Bank of England by the end of this year.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian
item.content:encoded: Sterling hit a 6-week high versus the euro on Wednesday after [USN:L8N45M06P TEXT:"data showed"] the UK economy grew faster than previously expected in the second quarter, cementing expectations for an interest rate hike by the Bank of England by the end of this year. The pound edged up 0.4% to a one-week high of $1.3292, recovering from a three-month low it hit in the previous session. Against the euro it was at its highest since mid-August, with the euro down nearly 0.3% at 85.43 pence. Economic output expanded by 0.5% in the April-to-June period, a touch higher than the initial estimate of 0.4%. Economists polled by Reuters anticipated no change from the previous estimate. Traders are pricing in around 33 basis points of monetary tightening from the BoE by year-end and more than 100 basis points by the end of 2027, LSEG-compiled data showed, although analysts broadly expect much more limited action. "You can see here very clearly a market that is overly hawkish. If we get a resolution by (November), the BoE may decide to stay on hold, but if it doesn't happen, then they'll be pushed to hike because the ECB has hiked, the Fed has hiked, the BOJ has hiked and they may feel a bit of pressure to do it," said Nicolas Trindade, a senior fixed income portfolio manager at BNP Paribas Asset Management. Also helping the pound gain on the dollar were comments from prominent US Federal Reserve policymaker [USN:L6N45L17G TEXT:"John Williams"], who said there was "no need for urgency" in raising rates. This prompted markets to lean in favour of a rate hike in December over October, the CME Group's FedWatch Tool showed. Dollar strength has weighed on the pound this month and wiped out gains for the quarter. Sterling is set for its biggest monthly loss in nearly a year and is set for a flat end to the third quarter. However, against the euro it was set for small gains on both the monthly and quarterly basis, primarily driven by euro weakness as investors priced in relatively dovish European Central Bank policy versus the BoE. The former is expected to hike rates by roughly 90 bps by year-end, LSEG data showed. UK markets are also heading towards a pivotal month where Prime Minister Andy Burnham's new government will unveil a budget. On Tuesday, Burnham said the country should [USN:L8N45L233 TEXT:"consider options"] for its future relationship with the European Union, including ultimately rejoining the bloc. Britain is still grappling with the economic and political consequences of the vote to leave the EU a decade ago.

item.title: Ukraine struggling to cover funding gap as war costs surge
item.description: Ukraine's total war costs will reach $155 billion this year and the government is struggling to close a $27 billion funding gap to ensure it can still conduct combat operations at the start of 2027, Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Olena Harmash
item.content:encoded: Ukraine's total war costs will reach $155 billion this year and the government is struggling to close a $27 billion funding gap to ensure it can still conduct combat operations at the start of 2027, Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said on Wednesday. Koretskyi said the government planned to cover $7 billion of the gap by postponing expenditure, reallocating money from other parts of the budget and cutting some costs, and was in talks with partners on how to cover the remaining $20 billion. It is the first time Kyiv has released an estimate of its annual war costs, meaning there is no comparable figure for 2025, but officials have said that the cost of the conflict has risen as the use of missile and drone technology has increased. The $155 billion figure covers both domestic state spending and off-budget military aid from Ukraine's Western allies, including air defence missiles, ammunition and aircraft delivered as hardware rather than cash. Koretskyi said it was critical that Ukraine plugged the $27 billion gap in its 2026 military spending, as this would help to cover defence orders for the start of next year. "Our ability to conduct active combat operations, including in the first quarter of 2027, depends on this funding. This applies to our long-range capabilities and our ability to take the war back to where it came from," Koretskyi said. "This is a critical need that must be met." BATTLE OF FINANCIAL ENDURANCE With the war in its fifth year and costs of the war soaring, the conflict has partly morphed into an exhausting battle of financial endurance. Ukraine's total budget revenues are targeted at about $70 billion this year and they are fully channeled for defence needs. The country depends on the military and financial support from its Western allies to be able to stay in the fight. Russia plans [USN:L6N45K0XS TEXT:"to spend"] 17.1 trillion roubles ($202.58 billion) on defence in 2027, around 27% more than the 13.5 trillion roubles originally budgeted, and the highest figure since the start of its invasion in February 2022. Ukraine is still finalizing its military spending plans for next year. In 2026, Kyiv has struggled to receive foreign aid and financial support on time and in full due to delays with implementation of reforms, corruption scandals and squabbles between government and parliament over unpopular legislation. Koretskyi said that $29.5 billion in foreign aid was at risk if Kyiv fails to meet its reform commitments with the IMF and the EU. "The government is working as quickly as possible to fulfil all its obligations by 15 October," Koretskyi said. "This is critically important. It must be done as quickly as possible."

item.title: Myanmar's Min Aung Hlaing to visit Malaysia in October, report says
item.description: Myanmar's junta chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing will visit Malaysia in October, Malaysia's state news agency reported on Wednesday, as the two countries continue talks on returning refugees and people displaced by conflict.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Myanmar's junta chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing will visit Malaysia in October, Malaysia's state news agency reported on Wednesday, as the two countries continue talks on returning refugees and people displaced by conflict. Malaysia [USN:L6N45L0GD TEXT:"deported"] nearly 1,500 Myanmar nationals on Tuesday on three ships sent by the Myanmar government, despite concerns from the [USN:L6N45M0GV TEXT:"United Nations"] and rights groups over the safety of those being returned to the war-torn nation. Myanmar has been in turmoil since 2021, when a military coup led by Min Aung Hlaing plunged the country into civil war. The retired general, who was elected as president after an April election dominated by an army-backed party, will be among several foreign leaders expected to visit Kuala Lumpur in October, Bernama cited Malaysia government spokesperson and Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil as saying on Wednesday. Malaysia plans to send back another 3,524 people to Myanmar in the second phase of its refugee repatriation programme, Fahmi was quoted as saying. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim would hold discussions with Myanmar in the near future to facilitate the return of more Myanmar refugees to their country, Fahmi added. Anwar rejected accusations that Malaysia was sending refugees back to Myanmar without concern for their safety, saying on Tuesday that continued engagement was necessary to resolve long-standing issues. Malaysia has said refugees from Myanmar, who make up the majority of asylum-seekers in the country, had created a huge financial burden and introduced security threats. "It's not true to say, just push them back ... We, of course, negotiate," Anwar said, according to a Bernama report on Tuesday.

item.title: Hormel Foods to buy Brakebush in deal valued at $1.06 billion
item.description: Hormel Foods on Wednesday said it will buy family-owned chicken company Brakebush Brothers in a deal valued at $1.06 billion, as the Skippy peanut butter maker looks to expand its presence in value-added chicken.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Hormel Foods (HRL.N) on Wednesday said it will buy family-owned chicken company Brakebush Brothers in a deal valued at $1.06 billion, as the Skippy peanut butter maker looks to expand its presence in value-added chicken. Consumers have increasingly sought protein-rich meal options amid growing demand for chicken as the focus on health and wellness grows.

item.title: El cobre sube tras datos manufactureros de China, se encamina a tercera alza mensual sucesiva
item.description: El cobre subía ligeramente el miércoles y se encaminaba a registrar su tercera alza mensual consecutiva, gracias a que la actividad industrial en China volvió a crecer, aunque la actividad bursátil se mantuvo moderada a la espera de una semana de festivos en el mayor consumidor de metales del mundo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El cobre subía ligeramente el miércoles y se encaminaba a registrar su tercera alza mensual consecutiva, gracias a que la actividad industrial en China volvió a crecer, aunque la actividad bursátil se mantuvo moderada a la espera de una semana de festivos en el mayor consumidor de metales del mundo. * El contrato de referencia de cobre a tres meses en la Bolsa de Metales de Londres (LME) subía un 0,2%, a 14.465 dólares por tonelada métrica, a las 0930 GMT, y se encaminaba a una ganancia mensual de alrededor del 1,2%. Ha sumado alrededor de un 8,2% en el tercer trimestre, tras alcanzar un máximo histórico de 14.875 dólares el 10 de septiembre. * La actividad en el sector manufacturero chino, gran consumidor de cobre, mejoró en septiembre, y el índice oficial de gestores de compras (PMI) subió hasta 50,1 desde el 49,8 registrado en agosto. Una encuesta privada de RatingDog reveló que la actividad industrial se expandió a un ritmo más rápido: su índice PMI subió hasta 52,1, su máximo en cinco meses, desde 51,5. * La demanda previa a los festivos siguió mermando las existencias de cobre en los almacenes de la Bolsa de Futuros de Shanghái (ShFE), ya que las existencias disminuyeron un 17,8% con respecto a la semana pasada, a 38.744 toneladas, el nivel más bajo desde enero de 2024. * La ShFE permanecerá cerrada a partir del jueves con motivo de la festividad del Día Nacional de China y reabrirá el 8 de octubre. * El cobre está encontrando apoyo en las expectativas de un equilibrio de mercado relativamente ajustado durante los próximos trimestres, afirmó Ewa Manthey, estratega de materias primas de ING. * La prima interna del cobre físico en China ha bajado desde el máximo de la semana pasada de 1.375 yuanes (205 dólares) por tonelada hasta los 1.050 yuanes por tonelada, pero la prima de Yangshan —un indicador del interés por el cobre importado— subió ligeramente hasta los 119 dólares por tonelada. * Entre otros metales básicos en la LME, el aluminio subía un 0,1% a 3.217 dólares por tonelada, el zinc caía un 0,3% a 3.856,50 dólares, el plomo perdía un 0,3% a 1.893 dólares, el níquel ganaba un 0,5% a 16.030 dólares y el estaño bajaba un 0,1% a 54.005 dólares. (1 dólar = 6,7045 yuanes chinos)

item.title: Czech and Italian government leaders table package to ease carbon, energy prices
item.description: The Czech and Italian prime ministers agreed a package of proposals for the upcoming European Union leaders' summit to ease energy and carbon prices, the Czech government office said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Czech and Italian prime ministers agreed a package of proposals for the upcoming European Union leaders' summit to ease energy and carbon prices, the Czech government office said on Wednesday. [USN:L1N45L09G TEXT:"The proposals"] include altering the usage of the EU's reserve pool for carbon credits; flexibility in free credits allocation for exposed industries; temporary measures to lower the impact of carbon prices on electricity production; easing regulations on methane; monitoring market positions in carbon allowances; and delaying the introduction of the second phase of the ETS emissions trading system.

item.title: Apple plans to make push into smart-home market on Oct 13, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: Apple is planning to make its long-delayed push into the smart-home market on October 13, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Apple is planning to make its long-delayed push into the smart-home market on October 13, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter. A smart-home hub code-named J490 is at the center of Apple's strategy and the company also plans to announce the first update to the HomePod mini since that device's 2020 debut and its first new TV set-top box since 2022, the report said. Apple did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill five people in Gaza, medics say
item.description: Israeli strikes killed at least five Palestinians in two separate attacks in the Gaza Strip on Wednesday, the territory's health officials said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Israeli strikes killed at least five Palestinians in two separate attacks in the Gaza Strip on Wednesday, the territory's health officials said. Medics said an Israeli airstrike on a vehicle killed at least four people and wounded 14 others in the Tel Al-Hawa neighbourhood in Gaza City, while an earlier airstrike on an apartment elsewhere in the city killed a woman. The Israeli military did not immediately comment on either of the reported strikes. Israel, which says Hamas has been rearming and launching attacks in violation of an October ceasefire, has stepped up strikes on the group in recent weeks. Hamas has denied trying to carry out attacks or rebuild its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the Gaza peace deal. Last year's US-brokered ceasefire calls for eventual reconstruction of the territory. But little progress has been made as negotiators have failed to agree terms for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its troops. Israeli airstrikes have continued. At least 1,400 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire, according to the territory's health officials, while Israel says four of its soldiers have been killed. Palestinian authorities say more than 74,000 people have been killed in Israel's assault on Gaza, launched after Hamas-led fighters killed about 1,200 people in southern Israel in October 2023.

item.title: Crudo sube, ya que falta de avances entre EEUU e Irán contrarresta recuperación de la oferta
item.description: Los precios del crudo subían el miércoles y se encaminaban a un fuerte alza mensual, ya que de las negociaciones entre Estados Unidos e Irán para poner fin a su conflicto siguen estancadas y la escasez en los mercados de combustible sigue respaldando los precios, pese a la recuperación de los suministros de crudo de Oriente Medio.
item.dc:creator: Ahmad Ghaddar
item.content:encoded: Los precios del crudo subían el miércoles y se encaminaban a un fuerte alza mensual, ya que de las negociaciones entre Estados Unidos e Irán para poner fin a su conflicto siguen estancadas y la escasez en los mercados de combustible sigue respaldando los precios, pese a la recuperación de los suministros de crudo de Oriente Medio. * A las 0944 GMT, los futuros del Brent para noviembre , que vencen este miércoles, avanzaban 57 centavos, o un 0,6%, a 103,16 dólares el barril. El contrato más activo, el de diciembre , ganaba 94 centavos, a 97,1 dólares. El West Texas Intermediate en Estados Unidos (WTI) mejoraba 82 centavos, o un 0,9%, a 90,2 dólares. * El Brent se encamina a un alza mensual cercana al 14%, el mayor desde julio, mientras que el WTI va camino de un aumento de un 4%. * El diferencial entre los dos índices también se ampliaba hasta máximos de cuatro meses, mientras los operadores siguen de cerca los posibles planes de Estados Unidos para restringir las exportaciones de gasóleo, lo que podría generar un exceso de oferta y llevar a las refinerías de ese país a procesar menos crudo. * Qatar declaró el martes que espera que la diplomacia itinerante entre Teherán y Washington pueda dar lugar a un avance decisivo. * Sin embargo, el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, desmintió informaciones de Axios y CNN que citaron a funcionarios estadounidenses afirmando que está dispuesto a aliviar las sanciones a Irán y a desbloquear los fondos congelados a cambio de medidas "concretas" en relación con su programa nuclear. * El martes, Arabia Saudita reanudó las cargas de petroleros desde su puerto de Yanbu, en el mar Rojo, tras reanudar las operaciones en su oleoducto Este-Oeste. * "La recuperación de los flujos de crudo debería mitigar las presiones sobre los precios impulsadas por la oferta, aunque es probable que la persistente escasez de productos y los elevados costos de transporte mantengan el mercado energético en general bajo presión", afirmaron los analistas del banco japonés MUFG.

item.title: Morning Bid: October doubts
item.description: On the last day of a brutal third quarter for bonds, a few questions have emerged about the now overwhelmingly hawkish interest rate outlook.
item.dc:creator: Mike Dolan
item.content:encoded: On the last day of a brutal third quarter for bonds, a few questions have emerged about the now [USN:L1N45K0MU TEXT:"overwhelmingly hawkish"] interest rate outlook. Even though Treasury yields continued to climb on Tuesday, with the long bond yield hitting its highest point since 2002, US consumer confidence readings plunged to [USN:AQN2MLCVJ TEXT:"their lowest"] level since 2014 this month as August job openings also [USN:L1N45K0MO TEXT:"fell more than forecast"]. There were qualifiers and questions in those releases, of course, with rising inflation expectations and stable readings on layoffs. But then New York Federal Reserve boss John Williams [USN:S0N44U01W TEXT:"cast doubt"] on market pricing that sees another Fed hike in October as odds-on. Williams said further tightening may be necessary by year-end but that the Fed may need time to gather more data before pulling the trigger again. The fact that bonds didn't react significantly to any of the above, nor to a [USN:L4N45K1PF TEXT:"more than 2% drop"] in crude oil prices yesterday, may be a worrying sign about market dynamics. But it may also be partly related to portfolio rebalancing at quarter-end, and we may need to see the fourth quarter underway for a clearer picture. As it stands, the whopping 82-basis-point leap in 10-year Treasury yields in Q3 is the biggest quarterly jump in four years. Wednesday offers up the August PCE inflation update and ADP's private sector jobs readout for September, while tech stocks will look to chipmaker Micron Technology's earnings release later in the day. A close eye will also be on the pumped-up dollar, which has [USN:L1N45M00D TEXT:"gained sharply this month"] on the back of the unfolding Fed tightening picture and as European Central Bank officials started to talk of a [USN:S8N42J01H TEXT:"more "measured""] policy stance after a series of rate hikes there. Elsewhere, Chinese business surveys for September perked up, [USN:L4N45L06S TEXT:"returning to expansion mode"] on the back of AI-related activity and government support. Reports have also emerged about worrying developments in one of China's leading AI models, Moonshot, with safety concerns now rife across the [USN:L6N45E0SV TEXT:"global AI space"]. And in Britain, Prime Minister Andy Burnham's annual conference speech to his governing Labour Party [USN:L8N45K1LP TEXT:"indicated changes"] to pensions and social care policies in the years ahead - and also left open all options for [USN:L8N45L233 TEXT:"rebuilding relations"] with the European Union, possibly even as far as rejoining the bloc. Chart of the day A torrid quarter for oil prices and bond markets comes to an end on Wednesday. This month's [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"interest rate rise"] from the Fed flew in the face of many long-held assumptions about the central bank outlook under the new leadership of Trump appointee Kevin Warsh. This shift in rate expectations helped fuel a surge of more than 80 basis points in Treasury's 10-year borrowing rate during the quarter - the biggest quarterly rise in four years. But as GDP growth and corporate earnings projections for Q3 picked up in tandem, AI-fueled stock markets [USN:L1N45M00S TEXT:"managed to deflect"] the bond squeeze. However, as the quarter draws to a close, there are some indications that the road ahead - with almost four Fed hikes priced into the futures market over the coming year - may not be all one-way traffic. New York Fed boss John Williams [USN:S0N44U01W TEXT:"reckons"] the Fed may pass on another hike next month, just as consumer confidence and job openings appear to slide. Today's events to watch US August PCE inflation data (8:30 a.m. EDT), September ADP private payrolls (8:15 a.m. EDT), final Q2 GDP (8:30 a.m. EDT) Fed's Lisa Cook and regional Fed presidents Thomas Barkin, Austan Goolsbee and Neel Kashkari all speak Before you go, [USN:L6N45L0QW TEXT:"check out my latest column"] on how soaring defence spending could give the AI investment boom a run for its money and what the convergence of the two means for restive bond markets. And listen to the latest episode of the Morning Bid daily podcast, where we discuss the uncertain Fed outlook heading into Q4. Subscribe to hear Reuters journalists discuss the biggest news in markets and finance. Want to receive the Morning Bid in your inbox every weekday morning? Sign up for the newsletter here . You can find ROI on the Reuters website , and you can follow us on LinkedIn and X . Opinions expressed are those of the author. They do not reflect the views of Reuters News, which, under the Trust Principles , is committed to integrity, independence, and freedom from bias.

item.title: BMW busca recuperar margens por meio de cortes e produção local
item.description: A montadora alemã de carros de luxo BMW apresentará planos para ampliar a produção local, em uma tentativa de recuperar as margens após uma série de alertas sobre lucros relacionados ao fraco desempenho na China, afirmaram analistas da Bernstein nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A montadora alemã de carros de luxo BMW (BMWG.DE) apresentará planos para ampliar a produção local, em uma tentativa de recuperar as margens após uma série de alertas sobre lucros relacionados ao fraco desempenho na China, afirmaram analistas da Bernstein nesta quarta-feira. A BMW deve divulgar sua atualização estratégica ainda na quarta-feira, durante um evento dedicado aos mercados de capitais para investidores, mas a Bernstein destacou os principais elementos do plano em uma nota após se reunir com a diretoria. A reputação de resiliência da empresa sofreu um golpe em junho, quando divulgou um alerta de lucros inesperado — o terceiro em pouco mais de três anos — relacionado à fraqueza no mercado chinês. O revés ressaltou os desafios enfrentados pelas montadoras europeias, que lutam contra a queda nas vendas na China e as tarifas dos EUA. A montadora sediada em Munique respondeu com um programa de demissões em massa que deve afetar cerca de 8.000 empregos na Alemanha, juntando-se à Volkswagen e à Mercedes-Benz (MBGn.DE) na redução de custos. A BMW, cujas ações caíram mais de um terço no último ano, atingindo seu nível mais baixo em mais de seis anos, está apresentando seu plano de recuperação em um evento de dois dias em Munique e em seu retiro em Gut Schwaerzenbach, na Baviera. A Bernstein afirmou que a BMW estabeleceria uma meta de margem de médio prazo de 3% a 5% para sua divisão automotiva até 2028. No início da década de 2030, a BMW teria como meta restaurar as margens para 8% a 10%, uma melhora acentuada em relação ao seu resultado mais recente de 2,3%. As ações da empresa estavam sendo negociadas com alta de 2,5%. “A BMW entende que a solução não é simplesmente cortar custos. Ela também busca o crescimento com produtos inovadores”, disse o analista da Bernstein, Stephen Reitman, acrescentando que a linha Neue Klasse, liderada pelo SUV elétrico iX3, é fundamental para o plano de recuperação. A BMW confirmará os planos de lançar um SUV de luxo posicionado acima do X7 e expandir suas linhas M e Alpina a partir de 2027 para fortalecer sua oferta premium, informou a Bernstein. Um porta-voz da BMW disse que os detalhes de sua estratégia seriam anunciados ainda nesta quarta-feira. Separadamente, a BMW informou que investirá cerca de 2 bilhões de euros na produção alemã de seu sedã esportivo Série 3 de próxima geração. De acordo com a Bernstein, as fábricas da BMW na Europa e nos EUA estão operando em plena capacidade, sendo a China “a principal área que requer ajuste na produção e flexibilidade de capacidade”. (Reportagem de Christina Amann e Rachel More)

item.title: FTSE 100 climbs on stronger UK GDP, on track for worst month since March
item.description: London's FTSE 100 rose on Wednesday as investors assessed stronger-than-expected GDP data, and was on course for a monthly loss as persistent inflation concerns and rising bond yields dampened sentiment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: London's FTSE 100 rose on Wednesday as investors assessed stronger-than-expected GDP data, and was on course for a monthly loss as persistent inflation concerns and rising bond yields dampened sentiment. The blue-chip FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) rose 0.26% to 10,664.93 points by 1018 GMT, headed for its biggest monthly loss since March and its seventh consecutive quarterly gain. The midcap FTSE 250 (.FTMC) climbed 0.74% but was set to dip for the month. Britain's economy [USN:L8N45M06P TEXT:"grew more quickly"] than previously thought in the second quarter, with output expanding by 0.5% in the April-to-June period, the Office for National Statistics said The data showed unexpected resilience in the face of geopolitical upheaval and a global bond market crisis The positive data helped cyclical stocks, with banks (.FTNMX301010) being the biggest boost to the index The utilities sector (.FTUB6510) rose 2.7% a day after UK PM Andy Burnham made a series of policy announcements for the sector Electricity firms National Grid (NG.L) and SSE (SSE.L) added about 3% each, while water companies United Utilities (UU.L) and Severn Trent (SVT.L) climbed about 2.3% each Energy stocks (.FTNMX601010) dropped around 1%, limiting gains Bank of England policymaker Alan Taylor said it was [USN:S8N42Q0DN TEXT:"unclear"] that it would be practical for the BoE to do a single rate hike to tame inflation without fuelling unwarranted market speculation of further increases Traders are pricing at least one 25-basis-point rate hike by the BoE this year, according to data compiled by LSEG Greggs (GRG.L) advanced 7.4% after the fast-food chain [USN:L8N45M070 TEXT:"raised"] its annual profit outlook as underlying sales growth accelerated in the third quarter Across the Atlantic, US personal consumption expenditures figures will be under scrutiny as investors look for clues to the Federal Reserve's monetary policy path

item.title: Madagascar villagers file claim against Rio Tinto over alleged mine contamination
item.description: More than 6,500 people in Madagascar have filed a claim in London's High Court against Rio Tinto , alleging contamination from the mining group's mineral sands operation exposed them to dangerous levels of lead and uranium.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: More than 6,500 people in Madagascar have filed a claim in London's High Court against Rio Tinto (RIO.L) , alleging contamination from the mining group's mineral sands operation exposed them to dangerous levels of lead and uranium. The claim relates to Rio Tinto's (RIO.AX) QIT Madagascar Minerals (QMM) mine. Communities near the site have previously protested over water releases from the mine into the surrounding environment, according to law firm Leigh Day, which is representing the claimants. The claimants allege acidic wastewater containing uranium, lead and other metals was discharged into lakes and waterways used for drinking, cooking, washing and irrigation. More than 2,000 of the claimants are children, the law firm said. Rio Tinto said it had been notified of the claim but had not yet received details. "We have yet to receive any documents or details of the claim so cannot comment further at this time," a spokesperson said. The company said QMM carries out extensive water monitoring and publishes results annually. Its 2025 Water Report found "most regulated metals were consistently below laboratory detection limits" in surrounding rivers. "All uranium samples tested were below laboratory detection limits, while the majority of lead samples were also below detection limits," Rio Tinto said in a written comment. The mine halted operations for five days in May 2022 after local communities protested over a water release that was followed by the discovery of dead fish. Rio Tinto said water sampling found no link between the release and the fish deaths. The mine, which is 80%-owned by Rio Tinto, produces ilmenite, which is processed into titanium dioxide, a white pigment used in products including paint, food and toothpaste. The claimants are seeking compensation and court orders requiring Rio Tinto and QMM to remediate damage and halt further contamination. The Jesuits in Britain, a Catholic religious order, [USN:L6N41J0I2 TEXT:"said"] in May it may sell its stake in Rio Tinto after unsuccessful engagement with the company over environmental concerns in Madagascar and Guinea.

item.title: Inflation jumps across euro zone, raising pressure on ECB to hike
item.description: Inflation rose far quicker than expected in some of the euro zone's biggest economies this month due to the energy-price shock of the Iran war, increasing pressure on the European Central Bank to raise interest rates again.
item.dc:creator: Maria Martinez, Balazs Koranyi
item.content:encoded: Inflation rose far quicker than expected in some of the euro zone's biggest economies this month due to the energy-price shock of the Iran war , increasing pressure on the European Central Bank to raise interest rates again. The ECB has lifted rates twice this year to prevent rapid price growth from getting embedded, and investors have sharply raised rate hike bets in the past few weeks as natural gas, petrol and diesel prices have all soared. France's harmonized [USN:L6N45M0GI TEXT:"inflation rate was 3.4%"] year-on-year in September, up from 2.6% in August, while in [USN:APNAL2HFW TEXT:"Italy it jumped"] to 4.1% from August's 3.2%, all above the ECB's 2% target, data showed on Wednesday. In Germany, inflation [USN:L8N45M0FG TEXT:"rose sharply in five"] key German states in September, suggesting Germany's national inflation rate —which will be released later on Wednesday — could increase this month. In Spain, the inflation rate rose to 5.0% in September from 4.6% in August, [USN:S8N4140CE TEXT:"data showed on Tuesday"]. Energy inflation appears to have surprised on the upside in all countries that have reported so far, and food inflation has also surprised on the upside, although much more modestly, said Mariana Monteiro from J.P. Morgan. The national data comes ahead of the euro zone inflation release on Friday. Inflation in the bloc is expected to come in at 3.6% in September, up from 3.2% in the previous month, according to economists polled by Reuters. HIGHER THAN THE ECB EXPECTED The ECB had expected inflation to accelerate from 3.3% in the third quarter to 3.6% in the final three months of the year, but economists say the actual peak is likely to be closer to 4%, given sky-high energy costs. Markets therefore expect another four interest rate hikes over the next year, on top of two moves already made this past summer. "With very few signs of a resolution of tensions in the Middle East on the horizon and winter approaching, a correction in energy prices is unlikely any time soon," Rory Fennessy, senior European economist at Oxford Economics, said. Under its "adverse" scenario, the ECB sees inflation at 4.0% in both the fourth quarter of this year and the first three months of 2027, and economists say current energy prices are more closely aligned with this scenario than its baseline. Furthermore, the dollar's recent strength will exacerbate Europe's inflation troubles, as key commodities are priced in dollars and the exchange-rate impact makes energy even more expensive in local currencies. Because this year's inflation surge has yet to generate dangerous second-round effects across the euro zone, a moderate policy response from the European Central Bank remains appropriate, ECB chief Christine Lagarde [USN:L8N45K12P TEXT:"said on Monday"]. Although core inflation has not yet moved up notably this year, the renewed spike in energy prices means core inflation could rise into early 2027, Fennessy warned.

item.title: Antin to sell majority of Vicinity Energy to Harrison Street, shares rise
item.description: Antin Infrastructure said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell a majority stake in Vicinity Energy to Harrison Street, sending its shares 6.3% higher.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Antin Infrastructure (ANTIN.PA) said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell a majority stake in Vicinity Energy to Harrison Street, sending its shares 6.3% higher. The deal gives Vicinity an enterprise value of $2.92 billion and is expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals.

item.title: Latvia's pro-Ukraine prime minister leads in poll ahead of Saturday election
item.description: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' centrist United List is expected to win the largest share of seats in Saturday's parliamentary election but is unlikely to secure an outright majority and will need to cobble together a coalition.
item.dc:creator: Andrius Sytas
item.content:encoded: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' centrist United List is expected to win the largest share of seats in Saturday's parliamentary election but is unlikely to secure an outright majority and will need to cobble together a coalition. Security concerns and cost of living issues have dominated the election agenda in Latvia, a NATO and European Union member state which borders Russia and is home to a significant Russian-speaking minority. The latest SKDS/LSM opinion poll indicates that seven of the 14 parties contesting the election have a chance of winning more than 5% of votes cast and thus enter the 100-seat parliament. Kulbergs presides over a broad coalition with New Unity, National Alliance and the Greens and Farmers' Union, formed after Evika Silina's [USN:L8N41R0LU TEXT:"government collapsed"] over [USN:L1N41N04A TEXT:"its handling"] of Ukrainian military drones entering Latvia's airspace, a consequence of the war between Russia and Ukraine . But in a sign of public disenchantment with politics, one third of those polled said they were either undecided or did not intend to vote, making the final outcome uncertain. A high proportion of non-voters and of ballots cast for parties that fail to clear the 5% threshold means the parties that do enter parliament will ultimately receive a larger share of seats than the poll figures imply. The following parties are seen as having the best chance of winning seats in the October 3 election, according to a September 4 to 16 poll by SKDS/LSM: UNITED LIST (14.4%) The centrist grouping of smaller parties was an also-ran in the 2022 election, and a junior coalition partner in 2022-2023. Its popularity soared in polls after backbencher Kulbergs [USN:L8N4251OE TEXT:"was appointed prime minister"] in May this year. A former racing driver with a hawkish stance towards Russia and a strong supporter of Ukraine, Kulbergs has a good chance of staying in power, polls show. SOVEREIGN POWER & ALLIANCE OF YOUNG LATVIANS (9.4%) This centre-left group was established in 2022 by politicians who were expelled from another party for refusing to condemn Russia's invasion of Ukraine. It seeks to attract the ethnic Russian minority vote. LATVIA FIRST (9.2%) The founder and leader of the centre-right Latvia First, veteran populist tycoon Ainars Slesers, has had business ties with Russian oligarchs. He is courting Russian-speaking voters by recruiting ethnic Russian politicians to his party and promising a more conciliatory approach toward the largest minority. PROGRESSIVES (6.2%) This left-leaning party is backed largely by young, socially progressive voters, founded in 2017. It was part of the government coalition until May after winning seats in 2022. NATIONAL ALLIANCE (5.6%) A nationalist party founded in 2010, it campaigns on a promise to protect family and traditional values. It was part of the ruling coalitions from 2019 to 2023 and joined Kulbergs' coalition this year. It promotes a hardline approach towards Russia and Latvia's Russian minority. GREENS AND FARMERS' UNION (4.8%) A coalition of conservative groups, it has been part of the current governing coalition since 2023. NEW UNITY (4.3%) The centre-right party won the election in 2022 and held the prime minister's post until May 2026, when Silina's government collapsed. It is at risk of winning no seats.

item.title: China Evergrande enters exclusivity agreement for potential sell-down of stake in property services unit
item.description: Evergrande Property Services on Wednesday said China Evergrande Group and CEG Holdings (BVI), its controlling shareholders, have entered an exclusivity agreement with a selected bidder for a potential sale of their shares in the company.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Evergrande Property Services (6666.HK) on Wednesday said China Evergrande Group and CEG Holdings (BVI), its controlling shareholders, have entered an exclusivity agreement with a selected bidder for a potential sale of their shares in the company. Here are some more details: China Evergrande Group, once China's premier developer, has defaulted on most of its $300 billion liabilities and is currently managed by liquidators. The signing of the exclusivity deal comes a year after the liquidators of the two parties [USN:L3N3UY0XI TEXT:"informed"] the indebted property developer that they were seeking to sell their shareholdings in the company totalling 51.016%. The parties have agreed to conduct exclusive negotiations in relation to the potential transaction for a period ending on October 27, Evergrande Property Services said. Negotiations are ongoing and parties have not entered any formal agreement, the property services unit added. Evergrande Property Services did not disclose the details of the selected bidder.

item.title: DeepSeek se alía con Huawei para desarrollar herramientas de programación de chips
item.description: La empresa china de inteligencia artificial DeepSeek dijo el miércoles que se ha asociado con Huawei Technologies para desarrollar herramientas de programación optimizadas para los chips Ascend de Huawei, la más reciente señal del estrechamiento de los vínculos entre las tecnológicas chinas en su búsqueda de alternativas al ecosistema de Nvidia .
item.dc:creator: Che Pan, Farah Master
item.content:encoded: La empresa china de inteligencia artificial DeepSeek dijo el miércoles que se ha asociado con Huawei Technologies para desarrollar herramientas de programación optimizadas para los chips Ascend de Huawei, la más reciente señal del estrechamiento de los vínculos entre las tecnológicas chinas en su búsqueda de alternativas al ecosistema de Nvidia (NVDA.O) . En una publicación en su cuenta oficial de WeChat, DeepSeek dijo que estaba poniendo a disposición como código abierto infraestructura de programación para la plataforma Ascend de Huawei, incluidas bibliotecas de cómputo y comunicación. El anuncio se produjo dos semanas después de que Huawei presentara su próxima generación de procesadores de inteligencia artificial y sistemas de cómputo basados en supernodos, y afirmara que esperaba que sus sistemas de IA se utilizaran ampliamente para entrenar modelos el próximo año. DeepSeek dijo que Huawei brindó pleno apoyo al desarrollo de la infraestructura de programación y que ambas compañías impulsaron conjuntamente una solución de "supernodo" basada en 128 chips Ascend 950, optimizando tanto el cómputo como la comunicación. DeepSeek también destacó el papel de TileLang, un lenguaje de programación de alto nivel y de código abierto para chips de IA, en la mejora de la eficiencia del desarrollo y la simplificación de la lógica del código. "Para construir una nueva generación de ecosistemas de 'software' para GPU independientes y bajo control propio, la principal prioridad es establecer un lenguaje de alto nivel que sea universal, fácil de programar y capaz de aprovechar todo el potencial de rendimiento del 'hardware'", dijo DeepSeek. "TileLang se creó precisamente para satisfacer esta necesidad" y ofrece "un modelo de programación más sencillo" que CUDA de Nvidia, dijo DeepSeek.

item.title: Decenas de heridos en protestas estudiantiles por los recursos escolares en Francia
item.description: Decenas de personas han resultado heridas hasta el momento en una oleada de manifestaciones estudiantiles, declaró este miércoles el ministro de Educación francés, Édouard Geffray, mientras los estudiantes seguían protestando contra el mal estado de los centros educativos, la falta de recursos y el estrés que les provocan los exámenes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Decenas de personas han resultado heridas hasta el momento en una oleada de manifestaciones estudiantiles, declaró este miércoles el ministro de Educación francés, Édouard Geffray, mientras los estudiantes seguían protestando contra el mal estado de los centros educativos, la falta de recursos y el estrés que les provocan los exámenes. Las imágenes de televisión mostraban filas de agentes de policía en Lyon y a estudiantes frente a sus centros educativos en Lille y en Saint-Denis, al norte de París. En Lille y Lyon se incendiaron contenedores de basura y otros materiales y, en Lille, algunas personas lanzaron proyectiles. "Desde el inicio de estas manifestaciones, hemos registrado 76 heridos, tanto entre los estudiantes como entre el personal", declaró Geffray a la emisora de radio RTL. Las manifestaciones y los bloqueos, que comenzaron la semana pasada y coincidieron el martes con una huelga más amplia del sector público, se han convertido en un punto álgido político en un momento delicado para Francia. El jueves, el Gobierno dará a conocer el presupuesto del país para 2027, que se espera que incluya recortes de gasto destinados a aliviar la presión sobre las finanzas públicas. Políticos del partido de izquierda Francia Insumisa se han sumado a las manifestaciones, y representantes y políticos ajenos a su bando han denunciado al partido por una retórica que, según ellos, aviva la ira de los estudiantes. Bally Bagayoko, un alcalde de Francia Insumisa en el centro de la polémica, ha afirmado que sus palabras se han sacado de contexto. El ministro del Interior, Laurent Núñez, dijo a la cadena BFM que unas 440 personas fueron detenidas durante las protestas del martes, la mayoría de ellas menores de edad. Núñez señaló que también se produjeron siete incidentes en los que se lanzó ácido clorhídrico contra las fuerzas del orden. Según la OCDE, el gasto francés en educación primaria y secundaria se situaba en la media de los países miembros y aumentó entre 2015 y 2022, aunque su porcentaje del presupuesto ha disminuido ligeramente. Los estudiantes que protestan afirman que las aulas están masificadas y que no hay suficientes profesores. El Gobierno ha calificado las protestas de irresponsables, pero ha reconocido que las dificultades en los institutos deben reconocerse y abordarse.

item.title: Un vol vers Israël dérouté en Arabie après un "incident" à bord
item.description: Un vol de la compagnie Flydubai à destination d'Israël, en provenance des Emirats arabes unis, a été dérouté mercredi vers l'Arabie saoudite après avoir émis des messages de détresse à la suite d'un "incident" à bord, a dit la compagnie aérienne, sans préciser la nature de cet incident.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un vol de la compagnie Flydubai à destination d'Israël, en provenance des Emirats arabes unis, a été dérouté mercredi vers l'Arabie saoudite après avoir émis des messages de détresse à la suite d'un "incident" à bord, a dit la compagnie aérienne, sans préciser la nature de cet incident. Tous les passagers sont sains et saufs, a-t-elle ajouté. Un responsable israélien a évoqué une bagarre entre les pilotes de l'appareil, un Boeing 737, plutôt qu'un détournement. Le vol FZ1073 parti de Dubai a été dérouté vers l'Arabie saoudite alors qu'il se trouvait dans l'espace aérien de la Jordanie après avoir envoyé un message d'alerte générale suivi quelques minutes plus tard d'une autre alerte évoquant une possible intervention non autorisée à bord, selon le site Flightradar24 spécialisé dans le suivi du trafic aérien mondial. L'avion a ensuite de nouveau émis un message d'alerte générale avant d'atterrir à l'aéroport de Tabouk dans le nord-ouest de l'Arabie saoudite, a ajouté le site spécialisé. L'incident ne semble pas avoir été provoqué par un détournement et la situation est maîtrisée, ont dit les services du Premier ministre israélien, Benjamin Netanyahu, informé de la situation. Toutes les dispositions sont prises pour permettre aux passagers israéliens de regagner en sécurité l'Etat hébreu, ont-ils ajouté. Un porte-parole de Flydubai a dit qu'un appareil de la compagnie avait rencontré un "incident" lors d'un vol à destination de Tel Aviv et qu'il avait été dérouté vers Tabouk où il a atterri sans encombres. Tous les passagers sont sains et saufs, a ajouté ce porte-parole sans fournir de précisions sur la nature de l'"incident". Un responsable israélien s'exprimant sous le sceau de l'anonymat a dit à Reuters que les pilotes avaient envoyé les messages d'alerte à la suite d'une altercation physique entre eux. On ignore si ces messages ont été émis volontairement. Yasmine Abou Kassis, dont la fille Miriam se trouvait à bord, a déclaré que cette dernière lui avait dit avoir entendu des cris et avoir vu un homme armé d'un couteau projeter un pilote au sol ainsi que beaucoup de sang. Flydubai assure des liaisons quotidiennes entre Tel Aviv et Dubai, destination prisée par les Israéliens. Israël et l'Arabie saoudite n'entretiennent pas de relations diplomatiques officielles.

item.title: Man City charges are moment of truth for UK plc
item.description: A commission found the 10-time English champions used sham contracts to mask $1.1 bln in funding from their Abu Dhabi owner. The soccer club denies it. But sanctions, as yet undecided, will test Britain’s institutional mettle given the inherent geopolitical sensitivities.
item.dc:creator: Liam Proud
item.content:encoded: A commission found the 10-time English champions used sham contracts to mask $1.1 bln in funding from their Abu Dhabi owner. The soccer club denies it. But sanctions, as yet undecided, will test Britain’s institutional mettle given the inherent geopolitical sensitivities. Full view will be published shortly. Follow Liam Proud on Bluesky and LinkedIn . Manchester City used "sham" commercial contracts as part of schemes to inflate revenue and understate costs by more than £900 million over nearly a decade, the Premier League said on September 29 after an independent commission ruled the club guilty of serious breaches of financial rules. The commission found City guilty of all charges relating to breaches of the league's financial rules over nine seasons, between the 2009-10 and 2017-18 campaigns, as well as three of four charges concerning their failure to co-operate with the investigation. The club, which denies wrongdoing, said in a statement it would appeal "on the basis that the opinion contains clear material errors, of law, principle and fact, and is unsafe". No sanction has yet been imposed, leaving unresolved the potential consequences for a club that has dominated English football over the past decade. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: F1-Ocon quittera Haas à la fin de la saison
item.description: Le pilote français de Formule 1 Esteban Ocon a annoncé mercredi son départ de l'écurie Haas à la fin de la saison, assurant cependant que sa carrière en catégorie reine n'était pas terminée.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le pilote français de Formule 1 Esteban Ocon a annoncé mercredi son départ de l'écurie Haas à la fin de la saison, assurant cependant que sa carrière en catégorie reine n'était pas terminée. Le Normand de 30 ans avait rejoint l'écurie américaine en 2025, en provenance d'Alpine. Il occupe actuellement la 16e place du championnat avec 13 points de retard sur son coéquipier britannique Oliver Bearman. Haas, la plus petite écurie du championnat, occupe la septième place sur onze du classement constructeurs. "Ma collaboration avec l'écurie Haas F1 Team prendra fin à l’issue de la saison 2026. Je quitte ce projet la tête haute, fier de mes performances dans des circonstances qui n'ont pas toujours été simples, pour diverses raisons et facteurs indépendants de ma volonté et hors de mon contrôle", a déclaré Esteban Ocon sur les réseaux sociaux. "Il reste encore de nombreux Grands Prix cette saison et, comme je l'ai toujours fait, je donnerai tout au volant, pour moi-même et pour mon équipe. J'ai toujours autant faim de réussite. Ce n'est absolument pas la fin de ma carrière en Formule 1", a-t-il ajouté. Haas a confirmé ce départ dans un communiqué séparé, remerciant le Français pour sa contribution. L'écurie dispose de plusieurs candidats pour le remplacer, le Brésilien Rafael Camara, soutenu par Ferrari, figurant parmi les favoris. Les chances d’Esteban Ocon de décrocher un autre baquet sont minces : Racing Bulls, propriété de Red Bull, et le nouveau venu Cadillac n’ont pas encore confirmé leur composition pour 2027, mais les deux écuries disposent d’autres options, notamment celle de conserver leurs pilotes actuels. Le Français, vainqueur avec Alpine (propriété de Renault) du Grand Prix de Hongrie en 2021, pourrait se tourner vers un poste de pilote d’essai et de réserve. Il avait déjà occupé ce rôle chez Mercedes en 2019 après avoir perdu sa place chez Force India (aujourd’hui Aston Martin).

item.title: Russell has high hopes for a favourite track he has yet to drive
item.description: Mercedes driver George Russell has high hopes for this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia at a favourite track he has yet to drive in real life.
item.dc:creator: Rozanna Latiff
item.content:encoded: Mercedes driver George Russell has high hopes for this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia at a favourite track he has yet to drive in real life. The Briton told reporters in Kuala Lumpur that the Sepang circuit was always the one he loved to race on as a youth living his dreams on a Sony PlayStation. "This is our first time racing here in Sepang, and it was actually my favorite circuit as a kid when I used to drive on the PlayStation," said Russell, who is fresh off a win at last weekend's [USN:L1N45I03R TEXT:"Azerbaijan Grand Prix"] in Baku. "So I'm sort of really looking forward to coming back and hopefully those experiences on the controller will help me go a bit faster this weekend." The October 4 race was originally scheduled to take place in Bahrain but has since been relocated to Sepang due to tensions in the Middle East. Sepang has not hosted a Formula One race since 2017 after the Malaysian government said it could no longer afford the hosting costs, though it remains a fixture on the MotoGP calendar and a favourite among motor racing fans. Just 10 of 22 drivers in the current Formula One field have raced at the Sepang track, while only three have won there - Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton, Aston Martin's Fernando Alonso and Max Verstappen of Red Bull, who came second to Russell in Baku. Despite their lack of experience on the circuit, Russell said he and his championship-leading teammate Kimi Antonelli remained confident of holding the edge. "Compared to the drivers who have raced here, in the past, I think we're very fortunate that we have the best chassis and power unit beneath us, which should give us the advantage over these drivers who have been here before. But, of course, the competition is always very tough," Russell said at an event hosted by Malaysian state oil company Petronas, a partner for the Mercedes team. Antonelli leads Russell in the standings by 66 points, with Hamilton in third 103 points behind. Mercedes is also leading in the constructors' standings, with 160 points ahead of Ferrari. Antonelli said unpredictable weather in Malaysia could pose a challenge for drivers, with rain forecast for this weekend and the country experiencing thick haze in some areas stemming from wildfires in Indonesia. "From what I've heard when it rains here, it's quite heavy. So we try to be ready for anything but also it will be the first time we'll be on track with the wet tires," Antonelli said. "So, you know, if that happens, it's going to be a big challenge for everyone because all of us have such little experience on the wet with these cars."
